newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain convicts three for plotting to kill king.
newsitem.headline: Spain convicts three for plotting to kill king.

text.p: Spain's high court convicted three suspected Basque separatist guerrillas of plotting to kill King Juan Carlos in 1995, state radio said on Monday.
The court handed down prison sentences totalling 109 years against Juan Jose Rego, Jorge Garcia and Ignacio Rego for crimes against the Crown and belonging to an armed band.
The trial started in Madrid on January 22.

In dramatic testimony, two of the three -- Juan Jose Rego and Garcia -- related how they rented a flat on the Mediterranean island of Mallorca with a direct line of sight to the king's sailing yacht and how they had him in their rifle sights three times.
Garcia told the court he did not shoot the king because escape plans had not yet been finalised.
The conviction comes a week after the Basque separatist rebel group ETA, which has killed some 800 people, murdered a young politician, sparking national outrage.
